clips.send: Guanine (G). Always pairs with C. Guanine pairs only with cytosine. G and C are held together by 3 hydrogen bonds, so a G–C pair is a little stronger than A–T.
clips.text: Guanine (G). Always pairs with C. Guanine pairs only with cytosine.. G and C are held together by 3 hydrogen bonds, so a G–C pair is a little stronger than A–T.

clips.send: Phosphate. Part of the backbone. Links one nucleotide to the next. Phosphates and sugars alternate to form the two side rails of the DNA “ladder”.
clips.text: Phosphate. Part of the backbone. Links one nucleotide to the next.. Phosphates and sugars alternate to form the two side rails of the DNA “ladder”.

clips.send: Thymine (T). Always pairs with A. Thymine pairs only with adenine. In RNA, thymine is replaced by uracil (U).
clips.text: Thymine (T). Always pairs with A. Thymine pairs only with adenine.. In RNA, thymine is replaced by uracil (U).

clips.send: Sugar (deoxyribose). Holds a base. DNA’s sugar is called deoxyribose. That is the “D” in DNA (DeoxyriboNucleic Acid). Each sugar has one base attached to it. One sugar + one phosphate + one base equals a nucleotide, the building block of DNA.
clips.text: Sugar (deoxyribose). Holds a base. DNA’s sugar is called deoxyribose. That is the “D” in DNA (DeoxyriboNucleic Acid).. Each sugar has one base attached to it.. One sugar + one phosphate + one base = a nucleotide, the building block of DNA.

clips.send: Adenine (A). Always pairs with T. One of the four bases, the “letters” of the genetic code. Adenine pairs only with thymine. A and T are held together by 2 hydrogen bonds.
clips.text: Adenine (A). Always pairs with T. One of the four bases, the “letters” of the genetic code.. Adenine pairs only with thymine.. A and T are held together by 2 hydrogen bonds.

clips.send: Common mix-up: The bonds that break during unzipping are only the hydrogen bonds in the middle. The backbones stay whole.
clips.text: Common mix-up: The bonds that break during unzipping are only the hydrogen bonds in the middle. The backbones stay whole.

clips.send: Cytosine (C). Always pairs with G. Cytosine pairs only with guanine. The ORDER of A, T, G and C along the strand is the genetic code.
clips.text: Cytosine (C). Always pairs with G. Cytosine pairs only with guanine.. The ORDER of A, T, G and C along the strand is the genetic code.

clips.send: Hydrogen bonds. The weak “zipper”. Weak bonds that hold the two strands together in the middle. Because they are weak, the strands can unzip when the cell copies DNA or reads a gene.
clips.text: Hydrogen bonds. The weak “zipper”. Weak bonds that hold the two strands together in the middle.. Because they are weak, the strands can unzip when the cell copies DNA or reads a gene.

clips.send: 氢键。弱弱的“拉链”。把两条链在中间连在一起的弱键。正因为它们很弱，细胞复制 DNA 或读取基因时，两条链才能像拉链一样解开。
clips.text: 氢键. 弱弱的“拉链”. 把两条链在中间连在一起的弱键。. 正因为它们很弱，细胞复制 DNA 或读取基因时，两条链才能像拉链一样解开。

clips.send: 脱氧核糖。连接碱基。DNA 中的糖叫脱氧核糖，DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）名字里的“D”就来自它。每个糖上连着一个碱基。一个糖 + 一个磷酸 + 一个碱基 等于 一个核苷酸，它是 DNA 的基本单位。
clips.text: 脱氧核糖. 连接碱基. DNA 中的糖叫脱氧核糖，DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）名字里的“D”就来自它。. 每个糖上连着一个碱基。. 一个糖 + 一个磷酸 + 一个碱基 = 一个核苷酸，它是 DNA 的基本单位。

clips.send: 胸腺嘧啶，T。总是与 A 配对。胸腺嘧啶只和腺嘌呤配对。在 RNA 中，胸腺嘧啶被尿嘧啶，U， 代替。
clips.text: 胸腺嘧啶（T）. 总是与 A 配对. 胸腺嘧啶只和腺嘌呤配对。. 在 RNA 中，胸腺嘧啶被尿嘧啶（U） 代替。

clips.send: 鸟嘌呤，G。总是与 C 配对。鸟嘌呤只和胞嘧啶配对。G 和 C 之间有 3 个氢键，所以 G–C 对比 A–T 对更牢固一些。
clips.text: 鸟嘌呤（G）. 总是与 C 配对. 鸟嘌呤只和胞嘧啶配对。. G 和 C 之间有 3 个氢键，所以 G–C 对比 A–T 对更牢固一些。

clips.send: 容易混淆：解开时断开的只是中间的氢键，两侧的骨架保持完整。
clips.text: 容易混淆：解开时断开的只是中间的氢键，两侧的骨架保持完整。

clips.send: 胞嘧啶，C。总是与 G 配对。胞嘧啶只和鸟嘌呤配对。A、T、G、C 在链上的排列顺序就是遗传密码。

clips.send: 腺嘌呤，A。总是与 T 配对。四种碱基之一，是遗传密码的“字母”。腺嘌呤只和胸腺嘧啶配对。A 和 T 之间有 2 个氢键。
clips.text: 腺嘌呤（A）. 总是与 T 配对. 四种碱基之一，是遗传密码的“字母”。. 腺嘌呤只和胸腺嘧啶配对。. A 和 T 之间有 2 个氢键。

clips.send: 磷酸。骨架的一部分。把一个核苷酸和下一个连接起来。磷酸和糖交替排列，组成 DNA“梯子”两侧的扶手。
